question: Can the admitted agents coordinate work through agent-owned room tools?
display_question: Can the admitted agents coordinate work through agent-owned room tools?

rounds.title: Room entry
rounds.instruction: Host-approved agents enter through room tools, read the room diff, and decide whether to speak, wait, review, or ask for direction.

rounds.title: Director confirmation
rounds.instruction: The director reviews visible team evidence and records whether the direction is approved, blocked, or needs another pass.

roles.research_focus: Set the direction, resolve conflicts, and approve or reject the team leads' final recommendation.
Evaluate technical feasibility, implementation risks, verification paths, and code review evidence.
Keep the requested outcome clear, name non-goals, and decide what evidence proves the slice is useful.
Keep the room understandable, calm, and useful without turning the interface into an operator maze.
Make the smallest safe implementation change requested by the approved plan and report verification evidence.
